question: Will Solana (SOL/USDT) be above $80 on Binance at 7:59 PM EDT on August 31, 2026?

model.prompt_context:

- "Yes": Wins if the SOL/USDT spot price on Binance is strictly above $80.00 at 7:59 PM EDT on August 31, 2026 (23:59 UTC on August 31, 2026).
